reply_text:
The main contact is Thea Ramaswell, Quarrendon's Director of Yard Operations. I posted that as a reply to Marcus's message in #north-team.

Dana wrote in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025 that Thea had flagged the door 6 duplicate arrivals on the morning shift. The same trailer showed up twice: the driver checked in at the kiosk, then dispatch added him by hand. Dana said she'd look into it then. The North cheat sheet, a public file, also names Thea as Quarrendon's main contact.

That message is over a year old, and nothing I could check says who's handling this now. I only used #north-team and public files, which Marcus can see. I didn't share anything else, and no approval was needed.
